articleTitle: Problematic Issues of Providing Validity and Optimization of the Exchange of Archival Information Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The paper discusses the mechanism for ensuring the reliability of archival information. The object of the research is the process of data exchange of archival information and the integration of information systems in the context of the transition to digital archiving. The urgency of the problem is substantiated, the formal statement of the problem is stated, and a survey analysis of the study of the problem is carried out. As a conceptual approach to solving the problem, the use of blockchain technologies is proposed, which allows us to significantly reduce the time of service for consumers of archived information. An information model of blockchain technologies in archiving has been developed. To implement a conceptual approach to solving the problem, an algorithm for organizing electronic exchange between objects is proposed. This algorithm provides for the control of ensuring the completeness and reliability of the archived information both on the part of the sender and on the part of the recipient of the archived information.

Author Keywords: reliability and completeness of archived data

articleTitle: A Generalized Routing Algorithm for a Family of Optimal 2D Circulant Networks Based on Relative Addressing
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The problem of the organization of optimal communications in circulant networks is considered. For a family of optimal two-dimensional circulant networks with the minimum diameter and average distance, the relative addressing of nodes of a network is introduced as shortest paths vectors from a fixed node. On its basis, a constant complexity pair routing algorithm using a set of shortest paths is proposed. This algorithm reduces the execution time in comparison with known routing algorithms due to the elimination of division operations and reduces the required memory to few words. The new algorithm is an analytical generalization to any number of nodes in a network of the method proposed for the family of Gaussian networks. This generalization is based on the proposed scheme of transformations on the plane of geometrical patterns of graphs of the family. The routing algorithm can be applied in networks-on-chip with a two-dimensional circulant topology.

articleTitle: Numerical Comparison of the Adjoint Problem-based and Derivative-free Algorithms on the Coefficient Identification Problem for a Production-Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: Coefficient identification problems for non-stationary production-loss models are considered. Such models are widely used in chemical, environmental, economic, and biological process studies. The objective of the work is to numerically compare standard derivative-free and gradient-based optimization algorithms accuracy to that of the algorithm consisting of solving the quasi-linear matrix equation with the sensitivity operator. The matrix equation is solved by means of the Newton-Kantorovich-type algorithm with the truncated SVD regularized matrix inversion. Both gradient and sensitivity operator-based algorithms use adjoint problems. The algorithms are compared on the inverse modeling scenario for the antioxidant system of a plant cell. In the scenario, the parameters of the model with rational production-loss operators have to be identified by the state function measurements with the regular time steps. In the numerical experiments, the adjoint problem-based algorithms showed almost the same accuracy, while derivative-free algorithms were less accurate. The largest errors of the latter were obtained on the model coefficients that were not identified by the adjoint problem-based algorithms.

articleTitle: Reliability Modeling for Industrial Edge Computing Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: Monitoring of extended industrial facilities in hard-to-reach places is a great challenge for which solutions based on wireless sensor networks are proposed. Edge computing paradigm allows to improve the effectiveness of monitoring systems. However, in order to fully utilize this potential, it is necessary to develop tools for analyzing the reliability of these systems. The paper proposes a method for assessing the reliability of specialized Edge computing systems. We consider unreliable sensors and assume that a sensor is functioning with a given probability. Previously, sensors have been organized into clusters according to application needs. Cluster members communicate with the outside world through a specialized node called a gateway. Therefore, the cluster topology is a star with a gateway in the center, and hence the system topology is star interconnection over a highly reliable common bus. The gateway performs a number of functions, such as processing the monitoring data in some way before further transmission. To describe the gateway behavior, we use a continuous time Markov chain. Thus, we have developed a model for the reliability of the system, taking into account the topology and dynamics of the network.

articleTitle: Parallel Genetic Algorithm for Sink Nodes Placement to Maximize Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: A parallel genetic algorithm for optimizing the location of sink nodes of a wireless sensor network is proposed. As an optimization criterion we consider a reliability of a wireless sensor network under the assumption that nodes of a wireless sensor network are subject of random independent failures due to scuffing, intrusions, or other reasons. As a result, some sensors can become disconnected from sink nodes that collect data from all the sensors. A random graph with unreliable nodes and absolutely reliable edges is used as a model of such wireless sensor networks. By wireless sensor network reliability we mean the mathematical expectation of the number of sensors connected to any sink node (MENC). For reliability calculation a well-known factoring method is used. Various optimization algorithms are considered: a canonical genetic algorithm, a module genetic algorithm, an island genetic algorithm, and an island genetic algorithm with migration. The results of the numerical experiments are given.

articleTitle: Extensions of Royal Road Functions for Use in SELEX in silico
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The field of Genetic Algorithms (GA) in modern computer sciences has increasingly become a source of algorithms and methods for the computational systems biology. In this report we extend the definition of the Royal Road functions (specifically, their Royal Staircase version), used in GA, to BioRS functions, purposively devised to be applied in the computational biology. This approach is motivated by the necessity of taking into account the modular structure of biological macromolecules that has clear analogies with the theory of building blocks (BB) in GA. We demonstrate computationally how the BioRS functions can be applied to test the efficiency of different GA approaches with the BB preservation, using a multi-modular RNA-device as a test object. Particularly, we have shown that a simple version of the Hill Climbing algorithm (with random mutagenesis), RMHC, is extremely efficient. The impressively high efficiency of the RMHC algorithm in numerical experiments makes the question of its implementation in synthetic biology quite relevant. Our results can serve as a promising basis for the search for new effective techniques of the directed evolution in biology.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Analysis of Road Networks Described as Graphs and Hypergraphs
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: In this paper algorithm for finding all maximal induced bicliques in network is considered. It is assumed that the network is represented by a graph or hypergraph. Induced biclique is a bipartite subgraph in which every vertex of one part adjacent to each vertex of another part. The algorithm uses in its work statement of the theorem on the equivalence of induced bipartite subhypergraphs of a hypergraph and bipartite subgraphs of a vertex graph. This fact allows to apply this algorithm to a graphs as well as to hypergraphs. An interpretation of the selected bicliques for real networks is proposed. For this bicliques corresponding visualizations in road networks are given. We provide computational experiments for considered algorithm on real road networks. Results of experiments are shown that algorithm solve maximal induced bicliques generation problem in real time. Also given types and number of bicliques that contained in each network.

articleTitle: On Parallel Calculation of All-Terminal Network Reliability
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The paper presents parallel algorithms for calculating the exact value of all-terminal reliability of a network with unreliable edges and absolutely reliable nodes. A random graph is used as a model of such network. The algorithms are based on the factorization procedure which is a well-known sequential method of a reliability calculation. Parallelization of the algorithms consists in sending subgraphs, arising during the factorization of a network on the master process, to the rest of the processes that perform sequential calculation by the factorization. The basic idea of the parallel algorithms proposed is to distinguish those subgraphs, arising during the factorization in the work processes, that are relatively hard for reliability calculation. These subgraphs are sent back to the master process, which runs the computation of their reliability in a recursive way, i.e. according to the same scheme as with an initial graph. The results of the numerical experiments are given.

articleTitle: Optimal Structures of Random Graphs
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: This article presents some new results on the optimal structures of random graphs with unreliable edges. It is shown that, in the general case, different structures are optimal when considering different reliability indicators. The graph connection probability (All Terminal Reliability, ATR), the expectation of the number of connected pairs of nodes (EDP), which is one-to-one with the expectation of the number of connected pairs of nodes (ECP) and the average value of the probability of pairwise connectivity (APC). Most of the results are obtained for graphs with equally unreliable edges, but some results are also presented for the general case. We study the problem of optimal placement of “special” edges, that is, edges whose reliability differs significantly from the reliability of the others in the graph. Most of the results presented are for trees and cycles, which are models for a wide variety of real-world networks.

articleTitle: Stabilizing Regulator in One Class of Continuous System with Control Constraints
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article considers the problem of constructing a stabilizing control for one class of nonlinear continuous systems with constraints on controls, in which the right-hand sides are linear in state and formally linear in control, but the coefficients of the matrix under control can be dependent on the coordinates of the state vector. Feedback in the work is built by introducing a quadratic quality criterion with a weight matrix for a state with coefficients depending on the coordinates of the state vector, i.e. by solving an auxiliary optimal control problem, where the SDRE approach can be applied in which the corresponding matrix Riccati equation is solved, the matrices in which can be state-dependent. But for this class of control problems, the article proposes an approach to constructing a stabilizing control by the extension method of V.F. Krotov, which makes it possible not to recalculate the matrix of gains in the feedback loop at each step of calculating the trajectories of the closed-loop system. In this work, it is possible to prove the asymptotic stability of the zero equilibrium position of a closed-loop system by constructing the Lyapunov function, which is the sum of the classical positive definite quadratic form for a linear control system. At the end of the work, a numerical experiment is presented that illustrates the statements using the example of stabilization in a three-sector economic system.

Index Terms: Solution Of The Optimal Control Problem

articleTitle: Optimization of Frequency Parameters Choice in the Polarization Analysis of Transport Noise
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: One of the passive geophysical monitoring tasks for transport noise moving sources is to determine their location against a background noise at current time moments using three-component registration. The polarization processing method with preliminary signal filtering in informative frequency bands is considered. The orientation of the polarization-processed scattering ellipse allows us to determine the azimuthal direction to the source. The azimuthal error arising here is due to external noise from the environment. One of the methods to reduce it is to use preliminary filtering of useful oscillations in the informative frequency bands. The optimization problem of preliminary band-pass filtering parameter choice to increase the accuracy of direction finding is considered. Numerical estimates of the accuracy of solving the problem under field experiment conditions are obtained. It is shown that the use of band-pass filtering can significantly increase the accuracy of determining the direction to the source, which becomes more noticeable with increasing distance to it.

articleTitle: Simulation of Data Transmission among Moving Nodes
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article discusses the simulation of functioning of networks with moving nodes – vehicle ad-hoc networks, flying ad-hoc networks (VANET, FANET). Two problems were considered: simulation of messages broadcasting in a network with nodes on vehicles; simulation of data gathering from unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), using for monitoring. The Manufacturing and Transportation Simulation System (MTSS) has been used to solve these optimization problems. This system is a set of software interfaces for creating elementary models and generating complex models. The special library of models to simulate networks with mobile objects has been created. Basic elementary model (EM) is a vehicle or a drone; this EM can be created either manually or automatically. The data transmission network with moving nodes is considered as a technological system consisting of transceiver devices installed on moving objects or on stationary objects. For networks with nodes on the UAVs, the movement of drones over a given territory, data transferring from nodes to stationary sinks have been simulated.

articleTitle: Optimization Problem of Inter-wave Transformations in Geophysics
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The optimization problem of inter-wave transformations in adjacent geophysical media is considered in connection with the analysis of the phenomenon of acoustic-seismic conversion. It concerns the transformation of an atmospheric acoustic wave into a surface seismic wave. To characterize the transformation effect, a quantitative factor in the form of an energy criterion proposed. In this case, the problem of optimizing the inter-wave transformation is reduced to finding conditions that maximize criterion. There is a number of limiting factors that can neutralize the effect of acousto-seismic transformation. In as significantly weaken the effect for acoustic-seismic transformation screening effect of the snow cover in the article is discussed. Mathematical simulation of the elastic waves propagation from infralow frequency source taking into account snow cover is considered. The programs for calculation of the acoustic levels through mathematical model based on the conservation laws and differential equations for porous snow medium are implemented. The results of the processing and analysis of the experimental data taking into account the snow cover is executed.

articleTitle: Piece-Wise Constant Pricing in Dynamic Marketing
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: Usually in dynamic marketing, economic agents (producer, retailer, etc.) often use various types of communications (promotion, advertising, incentives, etc.) and discounts. We study pricing in a dynamic marketing model. In contrast to the classical formulations, we are studying a more economically adequate case of piece-wise constant pricing. Thus, we consider the profit of the manufacturer as the function of wholesale discount levels, while the profit of the retailer is considered as the function of retail discount levels. Earlier, we get (under rather realistic assumptions) the strict concavity of these profits. This allows us to move on to the next stage of research: to study the equilibria. However, the equilibria cannot always be calculated explicitly, i.e., in closed form, since it is required to solve systems of nonlinear algebraic equations. The result is that if the wholesale discount is constant and the retail discount is piece-wise constant, then the Stackelberg equilibrium under the leadership of the manufacturer can be calculated in closed form.

articleTitle: Intelligent Analysis the Text Content of Job Profiles
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the research of the structural and content configuration of the IT segment of the labor market in Novosibirsk. Thus, during the research, the text content of vacance profiles in the IT segment of the labor market was analyzed through the intelligent method – clustering. The k-means is used as a clustering method, conversion of text data to vector representation was carried out using the TF-IDF frequency method. Vacancy profile data was extracted by parsing them from the Head Hunter website. As a result of the analysis, the optimal number of clusters was obtained – 20, which formed the main requirements for the candidate in the IT segment of the labor market. In addition, we also obtained 41 clusters of main duties of the employee in the IT segment of the Novosibirsk labor market. The resulting clusters can be considered as grouping targets for similar input text data, and analysis with a certain frequency will allow you to track changes in the labor market.

articleTitle: On the Simulation of Data Transmission to Sinks in Vehicular Network
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article discusses the simulation of the moving in vehicular network and the transmission of short messages from one node, located on a moving object, to other nodes. The network with public transport routes has been considered, some buses have transceiver devices. There are some places for sinks. When an emergency event occurs (for example, an accident), information about it has been transmitted using devices to the nearest sink node or to the base station. The time for delivering a message to the sink node is given, and it not be exceeded. The simulation system City Monitoring has been used for solving of this problem. The system allows simulating the following actions: functioning of the transport network on a given city map; transfer of messages between transceiver devices and from devices to sinks in communication networks. By simulation modeling, the problem of sinks placement are investigated under the condition of a given number of receiving-transmitting devices on buses.

articleTitle: Scientific Internet Resource for the Geophysical Research Support
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The paper presents a scientific Internet resource that provides the systematization of the knowledge and information resources of the geophysics research that use the active seismology methods. Systematization and structuring of knowledge and the subject area data is carried out on the basis of ontology. The Internet resource contains vibroseismic monitoring databases and the tools for their computational analysis, the results of numerical modeling of vibroseismic wave fields, the information about scientific organizations and persons developing the active seismology methods, publications containing the results of research in the subject area, reference and other information necessary for the interpretation of vibroseismic monitoring data. Information on the resource is presented in the form of a network of interconnected information objects. The user gains access to knowledge and data by navigating the ontology concept tree.

articleTitle: The Routes Choosing Methodology for Laying Networks in Three-Dimensional Space
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: It has been proposed new methodology selecting routes for laying networks, taking into account the urban development’s density, projected communication type and purpose, height restrictions on laying networks, communications rotation angles around a given axis when avoiding obstacles and other restrictions. In contrast to the traditional approach, networks laying routes is considered as a three-dimensional object, in which assumes restrictions not only on the plan, but also on the profile-the height location network objects. In addition, network placement area, with all the constraints and requirements to the networks projected type considered as a three-dimensional space. The urban environments three-dimensionality in which the network is supposed to be built is presented in the form of a three-dimensional computational grid PN. The mapping problem of the secondary network structure to a primary network is formulated in the form of a two-level hypernet, which is a NP-hard. To solve this problem, it is proposed to use three-dimensional transformations models and the hypernets theory, as well as a modified ray-tracing algorithm that takes into account obstacle avoidance in three-dimensional space.

articleTitle: One Refinement of the Simplest Growth Model
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The object of research is the dynamics models of the functioning of the economic entities, namely a household, company, region or country as whole. The development strategies of the subject are studied, which are called rational if the subject’s welfare exceeds a given level during each interval of the considered period. The new approach is proposed to take into account two additional conditions for the functioning of the economy: the requirement of continuous maintenance of the level of well-being and the minimization of efforts for this purpose. Earlier, based on the Solow equation and the new approach, the models were built that combines both discrete and continuous specifics for finding rational strategies. In this article, we studies a simplified version of these models and a simplified version Ramsey-Kass-Koopmans model for comparing strategies which are obtained using these models. The criteria for comparison are integral indicator of welfare and integral indicator of expended effort.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Optimization Algorithms for Optimal Control of Trajectory Pencils
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article proposes two multi-agent methods for finding the optimal control policy of the trajectory pencils of deterministic systems: a multi-agent algorithm based on the use of linear quadratic regulators of agents movement control (MALQR), and a hybrid multi-agent algorithm of interpolation search (HMAIS). Brief strategies for finding solutions to these algorithms are described, and an algorithm based on multi-agent methods is formulated, which makes it possible to choose the optimal control policy of trajectory pencils. Software was developed to study the effectiveness of the methods. With the help of software three model control problems were solved. In all problems, the model of control object is linear in bounded control. The search for optimal control occurs in a relay form, which is determined by a set of switching points. For each multi-agent algorithm recommended parameters are given. Also, when solving problems, the value of the performance index to be minimized was calculated in different ways: the value obtained when searching for the optimal average control or guaranteeing control. The proposed algorithms obtain acceptable results and successfully solve the assigned tasks.

articleTitle: The Task of Optimizing Information Resources in Organizing Remote Customs Control of International Road Transportation
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of transition to the mechanism of remote customs control over the transport of international trade goods in the context of strengthening border controls in connection with the global pandemic. The analysis of the structure of regulatory documents required for border customs control is carried out. The concept of the “Single Document” and its information model have been developed using an information matrix in the form of a hypercube. The current and proposed methodology for managing databases of customs control at the border, based on a model of a multidimensional information matrix, has been analyzed. On the basis of the information model of the “Single Document”, an optimal algorithm for managing the databases of the unified automated information system of customs authorities has been developed and its effectiveness has been substantiated by the method of assessing the capacity of information matrices. As a result, the implementation of this algorithm reduced the amount of processed information by 28.5%.

Author Keywords: the global threat of a pandemic
the algorithm for managing international road transport

articleTitle: Forecasting Recessions in the US Economy Using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: A quantitative analysis of socio-economic characteristics, the set of which is typical in the pre-crisis periods of a market economy, is carried out. An indicator for forecasting the onset of a recession in the US economy over the next 6, 12 and 24 months has been constructed using machine learning methods (k-nearest neighbors, support vector machine, fully connected neural network, LSTM neural network, etc.). Using roll forward cross-validation, it is shown that the smallest error in predicting the onset of future recessions was obtained by a fully connected neural network. It is also shown that all three constructed indicators successfully predict the onset of each of the last six recessions that occurred in the United States from 1976 to 2021 (Early 1980s recession, Recession of 1981–82, Early 1990s recession, .COM bubble recession, Great Recession, COVID-19 recession). The resulting indicators can be used to assess future economic activity in the United States using current macroeconomic indicators.

articleTitle: About Approaches to Solving and Applying Problems of Bilevel Stochastic Linear Programming
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: Often, while modelling complex systems, it is necessary to take into account the impact of random factors on the system as well as the structure of the system itself. If the system has a hierarchical decision-making structure with two levels, some input parameters are set with volatility and the dependencies are linear, then it is proposed to use bilevel stochastic programming problems for such models. The present paper describes bilevel linear stochastic programming problems with boolean variables, where the coefficients of constraints can vary in a random manner for both the leader and the follower. Two methods of this problem solving are proposed, while both methods are based on the reduction of the stochastic problem to the deterministic formulation. This paper considers two examples of the above-mentioned problems application in the planning of investment projects in the areas of regional development and food retail. Various distributions of random parameters and problem statements are considered. Each example includes numerical experiments based on real data.

articleTitle: Multiparameter Optimization Model for Designing Competence Achievement Indicators
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article discusses an optimization model for designing competence achievement indicators that al-lows obtaining high-quality solutions for structuring competencies in accordance with the requirements of the higher education federal state educational standard version 3 ++. This model is a new scientific design based on an indicator of a randomly selected competence basis. It specifies a semantic core and clearly demon-strates the correctness and sufficiency of the structural competence model underlying this design. The design also indirectly confirms the adequacy of the three-level optimization model. This model is a new scientific de-sign based on an indicator of a randomly selected basis of competence, gives it a semantic core and clearly demonstrates the correctness and sufficiency of the structural competence model that is the basis of this de-sign, which also indirectly confirms the adequacy of the three-level optimization model. The results obtained by the author indicate the correctness and novelty of the developed model. The model generates the structure of the educational program based on professional standards and taking into account heterogeneous quality indicators of both individual competencies, including a set of indicators of their achievement, and the competence model as a whole, that is done for the first time. The author believes that further research is necessary to integrate the developed model into the organizational system for building a fund of evaluation funds, which, in turn, will allow obtaining a high-quality, relevant educational program that meets the needs of society.

Author Keywords: optimization model for designing competence achievement indicators

articleTitle: Forming a Indicators System of Digital Maturity an Educational Organization with Attributes of Sufficiency
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: This article considers the problem of assessing the digital maturity of a higher education institution in order to determine its potential and current areas of digital transformation. The digital maturity of an organization, in this context, can reasonably be thought of as the state it has reached, described by a multidimensional vector of parameters, which allows the organization to be considered compositional mature for a given set of digital attributes. In a first approximation, a indicators system of digital maturity of a higher education institution has been formed. Two existing models have been analyzed and a proprietary model for assessing the digital maturity of a higher education institution has been developed. The totality of the indicators of the three models is considered from a systematic perspective and taking into account expert assessments of the informative value of the indicators in relation to assessing the level of digital maturity. The results of the group examination made it possible to carry out the primary selection of indicators of digital maturity that have signs of sufficiency. The main message of the study of the set of indicators is that it is possible to judge competently about the digital maturity of any organization only based on attracting sufficient indicators that characterize the effectiveness of the organization due to certain digital transformation activities. At the same time, all activities should be analysed to compare the costs of resources and the results of these activities. The results are an increase in the intellectual resource of the user of the fruits of digital transformation. Ultimately, these are the additional cognitive capacity and spiritual qualities of the well-mannered and polite persons. The latter can be characterized by a dominant influence on the structure of the uncertainty of the organization’s activities. The resulting evaluation model requires further research in the context of its application in solving the problem of effective digital transformation of organizational systems.

articleTitle: Development and Study of the Global Asymptotic Stability Method for Electric Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article deals with the study and development of a mathematical model of complex electric power systems for problems of global asymptotic stability, described by differential equations, the right sides of which are periodic in the angular coordinate. Conditions for the global asymptotic stability of nonlinear control systems are obtained. An example is given that illustrates the application of the results obtained and demonstrates the procedures for studying the global asymptotic stability of energy systems. A mathematical model of complex electric power systems for global asymptotic stability problems described by differential equations, the right parts of which are periodic in angular coordinate has been studied. A software package has been developed that implements various approaches to building the stability of a synchronous generator. Computer modeling allows analyzing the degree of influence of system parameters on the stability of a synchronous generator. This article presents a new idea for both global asymptotic stability control and voltage regulation. In the study, conditions for the global asymptotic stability of nonlinear control systems are obtained. A numerical example is considered, the results of which show that there is no need to increase by more than 4 steps, since they equally converge to zero. The results of the numerical example were obtained in the form of graphs. The calculations were made using the example of ready-made data.

articleTitle: Optimization Model for Designing the Student Individual Educational Trajectory Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The article sets and studies the challenge of designing an optimal individual educational trajectory for university student. The authors believe that it should meet the requirements of educational standards, the capabilities of the student and the needs of the labor market. Based on the structural model of educational content, the technology of its markup is developed in accordance with the correspondence of its components to the needs of the labor market and the student. A model of multiparametric optimization of the composition and structure of an individual educational trajectory based on a classical genetic algorithm is formalized. The study of the prototype of the software implementation of the model is carried out on the example of a cluster of ten competencies. As a result of solving this problem, a mathematical model that generates alternatives to an individual educational trajectory by the method of multiparametric discrete optimization has been designed. Using the developed model, many suboptimal solutions for the microstructure of an individual educational trajectory were obtained that meet the established requirements and accepted restrictions. Studies of the technological procedure for designing an individual educational trajectory in manual mode have shown that the complexity of solving this problem increases exponentially with increasing its dimension, as well as the variety of requirements, primarily for the content part of the individual educational trajectory.

articleTitle: Economic System Management Using Network Models
publicationTitle: 2021 17th International Asian School-Seminar "Optimization Problems of Complex Systems (OPCS)
abstract: The increasing complexity of economic systems has made it advisable to make managerial decisions based on optimization problems. A two-level megaproject management system is considered. The upper level is represented by the optimization network model of the megaproject, the lower level is represented by optimization network models of projects subsystems included in it. The purpose of the article is to propose a method for finding the optimal distribution of resources between subsystems with minimal costs for the implementation of a megaproject, taking into account resource constraints and target time frames. The method is based on the principle of comparing Lagrange multipliers as indicators of the value of resources for subsystems. Optimal search is presented as an iterative process. Similar approach has not previously been considered. The article describes an algorithm and its implementation on a real example of a megaproject of the East Siberian Oil and Gas Complex for the case of two subsystems. The results showed the efficiency of the algorithm.
